title: Personal Loan EMI
shortAnswer: Calculate monthly EMI for a personal loan.
longAnswer: The Personal Loan EMI Calculator computes the monthly instalment from the principal, annual interest rate, and tenure, using the reducing-balance EMI formula. It shows the EMI, total interest, and total repayment, and the amortisation splits each instalment into interest and principal. Personal loan interest is not deductible for a salaried individual; it is deductible only if the loan is used for a business purpose and the interest is a business expense, or in limited cases where the loan is used to buy a house (then 24(b) may apply). The calculator is a repayment tool and does not compute any tax deduction. Personal loans usually carry a higher rate than secured loans and may have a processing fee and prepayment penalty—include those in your comparison. Enter the amount, rate, and tenure to see the EMI. Confirm the rate and charges with your lender before signing.
